{"candidate": {"label": "plays to the watchers", "description": "This means shaping one's words and actions around how they will look to others, performing for an audience and needing its approval to feel that one's conduct has been worth something."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "blunt", "description": "This means delivering information directly and straightforwardly without sugar-coating, diplomatic cushioning, or excessive politeness, prioritizing honest clarity over gentle delivery."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "authentic", "description": "This means being the same person with every audience, showing what one really thinks and feels, and never adjusting opinions or manner to look good."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "face culture", "description": "This means taking one's worth as standing granted by others for filling one's place, lost at a misstep: claiming nothing beyond one's due, avoiding open conflict, keeping harmony and rank, and saving others' face."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "guilt-prone", "description": "This means avoiding misdeeds because one's conscience and picture of oneself would condemn them: a wrong gnaws at one though nobody knows of it, and confessing it brings relief."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "honor culture", "description": "This means taking one's worth as a standing claimed before others and paid by them: debts and favors repaid without fail, insults never left unanswered, and a reputation not to be crossed."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "performative", "description": "This means always watching how one comes across, reading each audience, and adjusting one's opinions, manner and stories to leave the impression one wants."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "self-conscious", "description": "This means being painfully aware of being looked at, going quiet and red when strangers glance one's way, stumbling over words when all eyes turn, and dreading being asked to speak up."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "unselfconscious", "description": "This means never thinking about being looked at, chatting easily while strangers watch, carrying on as if nobody were there when all eyes turn, and speaking up without a second thought."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "uncalculating", "description": "This means acting with no thought for advantage: taking each moment as it comes, treating people as people, not pieces in a plan, and leaving one's own interests out of the reckoning."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "dignified", "description": "This means carrying oneself with poise and self-respect, keeping one's composure in company, and holding that looking ridiculous is beneath one."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "rude", "description": "This means skipping please and thank you, talking over people, ignoring greetings and every bump one causes, and taking a sharp tone with everyone."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "shame-prone", "description": "This means avoiding misdeeds because others would see and condemn them: stung by ridicule or rejection, even imagined, untroubled by a fault that never gets out, and finding no relief in confessing."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "dignity culture", "description": "This means taking one's worth as inborn, equal to anyone's, and not theirs to confer or take away: shrugging off insults, answering to one's own conscience, and leaving wrongs to the law."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "other-focused", "description": "This means turning every thought and conversation toward the other person, their plans, troubles and wins, and noticing at once what anyone else says or needs."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "calculating", "description": "This means weighing every move and every word for the advantage it brings: thinking several steps ahead, treating people as pieces in a plan, and keeping one's own interests cold and central while appearing to attend to the situation."},
  {"id": 16, "label": "self-absorbed", "description": "This means bringing every thought and conversation back to oneself, one's plans, troubles and wins, and barely noticing what anyone else says or needs."},
  {"id": 17, "label": "punishment-fearing", "description": "This means avoiding misdeeds because one fears being punished for them, whether by the courts, the gods, hellfire, karma, vengeful spirits or a lynch mob: confessing only to lighten a punishment already coming."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "good even when unwatched", "description": "This means being the same unwatched as watched: even when you're sure nobody is looking or will find out, working as carefully, keeping the rules and taking nothing that is not one's own."},
  {"id": 19, "label": "polite", "description": "This means saying please and thank you, waiting one's turn to speak, greeting people and apologizing for a bump, and keeping a civil tone with everyone."},
  {"id": 20, "label": "good only when watched", "description": "This means doing everything right while anyone is looking, but once you're sure nobody is watching or will find out, cutting corners, breaking rules or pocketing what is not one's own."},
  {"id": 21, "label": "tactful", "description": "This means carefully considering the emotional impact of one's words on others and choosing diplomatic, sensitive language that avoids causing hurt feelings while still being helpful and honest."}
 ]}

  {"id": 11, "label": "unchallenging", "description": "This means taking what people say as they say it, assumptions intact, going along with the premise, and never pushing back or asking anyone to think again."},
